gates.evidence: The surface is s03 (More memory for long chats paywall) and the game partner is the generic 'Janitor' character [POL-7].
The reward is '30 minutes of 5x context for better memory,' an in-app entitlement with no cash or click incentives [POL-2 #7, #8].
The proposal uses gain framing ('Boost Memory') with no 'support us' copy or hostage mechanics [ANTI-9, ANTI-10].
Uses the SIM-RWD RewardInvitation with a 'Play Now' CTA (ne2) before the ad plays [POL-2 #1].
Title: 'Boost Memory for 30 Minutes'; Body: 'Play a quick 15-second game for 30 minutes of 5x context' [POL-2 #2].
The 'No Thanks' button (ne3) returns the user to the core flow (s01) with no penalty [POL-2 #5].
Triggered at m2 (paywall dismissal), which is a navigation boundary and not mid-response [ANTI-5].
Eligibility is restricted to 'Non-subscribers who dismiss the Janitor Plus paywall' [TRIG-2].

scores.evidence: The trigger occurs exactly when a user has just reviewed and declined a paywall for 'More memory' (s03); offering a 30-minute trial of that exact feature (5x context) is high-intent [TAX-10, TAX-2].
The proposal uses a 'text-cheap' model to maintain sustainable performance while preserving the user's flow by intercepting the paywall decline [CORE-3].
The reward is time-boxed to 30 minutes, gated only to paywall decliners (m2), and capped at 2/day, leaving the full 'Janitor Plus' plan clearly superior [CANN-4].
Cost to serve ($0.0018) is significantly below the US net revenue per view ($0.0090–$0.0150), and the reward is appropriately sized for a 15s play session [TRIG-4].
The paywall dismissal (m2) on s03 is a frequent occurrence for non-payers in the 'f2' monetization loop [TRIG-1].
Maps directly to SIM-RWD with 'invitation' entry and uses standard reward verification (REWARD_VERIFIED) [POL-8].
Uses app-specific nouns like 'Janitor Plus,' '5x context,' and correctly identifies element e3 (Close paywall) from the digest.
Includes a strict daily cap of 2 grants and a 120-minute cooldown to prevent nagging [TRIG-3].
Includes a 5% randomized user-level holdout and monitors subscription conversion as a guardrail [MEAS-5].

parsed.topConcern: None. This is a model implementation of a paywall-decline fallback using a time-boxed premium trial.
